description: ALTER COLUMN SET/DROP NOT NULL and DEFAULT behaviour, converted 1:1 from ddl/AlterColumnNullDefaultTest.java (now retired). Includes the regression that ALTER COLUMN ... DROP NOT NULL/DEFAULT must not be dispatched as a table-level DROP COLUMN.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE nn_t (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
ALTER TABLE nn_t ALTER COLUMN name SET NOT NULL
INSERT INTO nn_t VALUES (1, NULL)
ALTER TABLE nn_t ALTER COLUMN name DROP NOT NULL
INSERT INTO nn_t VALUES (2, NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nn_t
CREATE TABLE def_t (id INTEGER, qty INTEGER DEFAULT 5)
ALTER TABLE def_t ALTER COLUMN qty SET DEFAULT 7
INSERT INTO def_t (id) VALUES (1)
SELECT qty FROM def_t WHERE id = 1
CREATE TABLE keep_t (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
DESCRIBE TABLE keep_t
ALTER TABLE keep_t ALTER COLUMN name SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE keep_t ALTER COLUMN name DROP NOT NULL
DESCRIBE TABLE keep_t
ALTER TABLE keep_t ALTER COLUMN name DROP DEFAULT
DESCRIBE TABLE keep_t
INSERT INTO keep_t (id, name) VALUES (1, NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM keep_t
ALTER TABLE keep_t DROP COLUMN name
DESCRIBE TABLE keep_t
